--- terminal do script
on t(cmd)
    tell application "Terminal"
        activate
        do script cmd
        do script cmd in window 1
        do script "echo " & quoted form of cmd in front window
        set w to do script ""
        do script cmd in w
        return w
    end tell
end t
--- terminal windows and tabs
on t()
    tell application "Terminal"
        set n to count of windows
        set a to name of front window
        set b to custom title of selected tab of front window
        set c to busy of tab 1 of window 1
        set d to contents of selected tab of window 1
        set e to history of tab 1 of window 1
        set f to processes of tab 1 of window 1
        set g to tty of tab 1 of window 1
        set h to (every tab of window 1 whose busy is true)
        return {n, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}
    end tell
end t
--- terminal settings
on t(s)
    tell application "Terminal"
        set current settings of selected tab of front window to settings set s
        set custom title of selected tab of front window to "t"
        set number of rows of front window to 40
        set number of columns of front window to 120
        set background color of selected tab of front window to {0, 0, 0}
        set bounds of front window to {0, 0, 800, 600}
        set miniaturized of front window to true
        set frontmost of window 1 to true
        return {name of default settings, name of startup settings, name of every settings set, font name of current settings of tab 1 of window 1}
    end tell
end t
--- terminal wait until done
on t(cmd)
    tell application "Terminal"
        set theTab to do script cmd
        repeat while busy of theTab
            delay 0.5
        end repeat
        set out to contents of theTab
        close (every window whose tabs contains theTab)
        return out
    end tell
end t
--- terminal close and quit
on t()
    tell application "Terminal"
        close front window
        close window 1 saving no
        close every window
        if (count of windows) is 0 then quit
    end tell
end t
--- safari documents and urls
on t(u)
    tell application "Safari"
        activate
        set a to URL of front document
        set b to name of front document
        set c to URL of current tab of front window
        set d to source of document 1
        set e to text of document 1
        set URL of front document to u
        open location u
        make new document with properties {URL:u}
        return {a, b, c, d, e}
    end tell
end t
--- safari tabs
on t(u)
    tell application "Safari"
        tell front window
            set n to count of tabs
            set names to name of every tab
            set urls to URL of every tab
            set current tab to tab 1
            make new tab at end of tabs with properties {URL:u}
            set current tab to (make new tab with properties {URL:u})
            close tab 2
            close (every tab whose URL contains "example")
        end tell
        return {n, names, urls, index of current tab of front window, visible of tab 1 of window 1}
    end tell
end t
--- safari do javascript
on t(js)
    tell application "Safari"
        set a to do JavaScript js in document 1
        set b to do JavaScript "document.title" in current tab of front window
        set c to do JavaScript ("document.getElementById('" & js & "').value") in front document
        do JavaScript "window.scrollTo(0, 0)" in tab 1 of window 1
        tell front document to do JavaScript js
        return {a, b, c}
    end tell
end t
--- safari wait for page
on t(u)
    tell application "Safari"
        set URL of front document to u
        repeat until (do JavaScript "document.readyState" in front document) is "complete"
            delay 0.2
        end repeat
        return name of front document
    end tell
end t
--- safari windows and misc
on t(q)
    tell application "Safari"
        set a to bounds of front window
        set b to id of front window
        set c to name of every window
        set d to every document
        search the web for q
        add reading list item q
        show bookmarks
        close every window
        return {a, b, c, d}
    end tell
end t
--- mail new message
on t(subj, body, addr)
    tell application "Mail"
        set m to make new outgoing message with properties {subject:subj, content:body, visible:true}
        tell m
            make new to recipient at end of to recipients with properties {address:addr}
            make new cc recipient at end of cc recipients with properties {name:"n", address:addr}
            make new bcc recipient with properties {address:addr}
            set sender to addr
        end tell
        send m
        return m
    end tell
end t
--- mail attachment
on t(p)
    tell application "Mail"
        set m to make new outgoing message with properties {subject:"s", content:"c" & return & return}
        tell content of m
            make new attachment with properties {file name:p} at after last paragraph
        end tell
        set visible of m to true
        activate
    end tell
end t
--- mail reading messages
on t()
    tell application "Mail"
        set unread to every message of inbox whose read status is false
        set out to {}
        repeat with m in unread
            set end of out to {subject of m, sender of m, date received of m, content of m}
            set read status of m to true
            set flagged status of m to false
        end repeat
        return {out, count of messages of inbox, unread count of inbox}
    end tell
end t
--- mail accounts and mailboxes
on t(a, b)
    tell application "Mail"
        set names to name of every account
        set boxes to name of every mailbox of account a
        set box to mailbox b of account a
        set n to count of messages of box
        set m to first message of box
        move m to mailbox "Archive" of account a
        delete (every message of box whose subject contains "spam")
        check for new mail
        check for new mail for account a
        return {names, boxes, n, email addresses of account a, user name of account a, enabled of account a}
    end tell
end t
--- mail selection and headers
on t()
    tell application "Mail"
        set sel to selection
        if sel is {} then return missing value
        set m to item 1 of sel
        set a to all headers of m
        set b to source of m
        set c to address of every to recipient of m
        set d to name of every mail attachment of m
        set e to message id of m
        set f to mailbox of m
        set g to extract address from sender of m
        set h to extract name from sender of m
        return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}
    end tell
end t
--- mail save attachments
on t(folderPath)
    tell application "Mail"
        repeat with m in (get selection)
            repeat with a in mail attachments of m
                save a in file (folderPath & name of a)
            end repeat
        end repeat
    end tell
end t
--- mail rule handler
using terms from application "Mail"
    on perform mail action with messages theMessages for rule theRule
        tell application "Mail"
            repeat with m in theMessages
                set s to subject of m
                if s contains "x" then set flag index of m to 1
            end repeat
        end tell
    end perform mail action with messages
end using terms from
--- mail viewers and signatures
on t()
    tell application "Mail"
        set v to message viewer 1
        set a to selected messages of v
        set b to selected mailboxes of v
        set c to name of every signature
        set d to visible messages of v
        return {a, b, c, d, application version, always bcc myself, download html attachments}
    end tell
end t
--- three applications together
on t(u)
    tell application "Safari" to set pageTitle to name of front document
    tell application "Terminal" to do script "echo " & quoted form of pageTitle
    tell application "Mail"
        set m to make new outgoing message with properties {subject:pageTitle, content:u}
        tell m to make new to recipient with properties {address:"a@example.com"}
    end tell
    tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first process whose frontmost is true
    return {pageTitle, frontApp}
end t
--- names that are words of an application
on t(x)
    set tabs to 1
    set subject to 3
    set busy to 4
    tell application "Safari"
        set a to URL of document 1
        set b to my helper(|tabs|)
        set c to |tabs| + busy
    end tell
    tell application "Mail"
        set d to subject of item 1 of x
        set e to |subject| + tabs
    end tell
    tell application "Terminal"
        set f to |busy| + subject
    end tell
    return {tabs, subject, busy, a, b, c, d, e, f}
end t

on helper(v)
    return v
end helper
